title: Hidden Order · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Hidden Order · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: The lead secretly arranges three colored papers and covers them. A partner proposes an order; the lead says how many colors are in the correct position, then the partner makes a second proposal. The second proposal matches the hidden order. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: Three colored papers.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Hidden Order, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The second proposal matches the hidden order.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The second proposal matches the hidden order.
